item.subject: science
item.stem: During a school garden activity, Meena pulled out a small mustard plant and washed its roots. She saw one thick main root growing straight down with many thin side roots branching from it. Which root system does the mustard plant have?

options.A: A fibrous root system, because the side roots are thin and many in number.
options.B: A taproot system, because one main root grows downward with smaller side roots arising from it.
options.C: A fibrous root system, because all garden plants have a bunch of similar thin roots.
options.D: A taproot system, because the roots were washed and could be seen clearly.
